title.en: The One Where Fina Takes a Turn

description.es: Mientras Fina está en la tienda, entra Marta. Le dice que no tiene por qué trabajar mientras su padre está enfermo, que ya se la ve muy cansada y que debería descansar. Fina sigue trabajando, pero, mientras atiende a una clienta, empeora. Jaime y Marta hablan sobre Isidro y Fina. Jaime propone que salgan a cenar esa noche.
description.en: While Fina is at the store, Marta comes in. She tells her that she does not have to work while her father is ill, that she already looks very tired, and that she should rest. Fina keeps working, but while attending to a customer she takes a turn for the worse. Jaime and Marta talk about Isidro and Fina. Jaime suggests they go out to dinner that evening.
